headline: ARI @ SEA matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is ARI 3.25 at SEA 3.73, with a projected total of 6.98. Movement read: Both offenses moved down (ARI -0.48, SEA -0.54), so the movement points more toward run suppression than a clearer side. The projected total fell -1.02, which points to a lower-run game script than the earliest saved read. NRFI probability dropped -7.1%, so the first-inning read became more YRFI/early-scoring friendly. Pitching context: Bryce Miller has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 1.3 ER over the last 3 outings. Batter research is strongest for Julio Rodríguez, Ketel Marte, Corbin Carroll, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Rob Refsnyder because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
